title: Integration-normalized vector-bundle comparison in coordinates
statement:
Fix the finite purity datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_F$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$. Let $Z$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $\pi:V\to Z$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $d\geq0$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Use small pro-etale derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and the specified coefficient twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let
$$c_\pi:A_V(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}R\pi^!A_Z$$
be the inverse of the integration-normalized unit-object comparison of [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity], transported from its ordinary etale realization by [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison].
Let $u:U\hookrightarrow Z$ be a Zariski open subscheme, $V_U=V\times_ZU$, and let $\phi:V_U\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf A^d_U$ be a linear trivialization over $U$. Write $p_d:\mathbf A^d_U\to U$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Identify restrictions of $R\pi^!A_Z$ with $Rp_d^!A_U$ through the canonical exceptional exchange for $u$ and the change of coordinates $\phi$, and identify the twists by canonical Tate pullback. Then
$$c_\pi|_{V_U}=\Gamma_{p_d,A_U}:A_{\mathbf A^d_U}(d)[2d]\longrightarrow Rp_d^!A_U.$$
Here $\Gamma_{p_d,A_U}$ is the ordered affine-line comparison, with each rank-one map the transpose of the restricted projective-line trace and with the exceptional-composition and twist associators of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]; its construction for every $n\geq1$ is the one explicitly specified in [lem-pur-projection-purity-agreement]. The assertion includes $d=0$, where this is the identity, and is independent of the choice of $r\geq1$ with $\ell^rA=0$.

proof.text: Use the canonical coordinate interface [def-pur-vector-chart-comparison-coordinates]; its already proved open_geometry and unit_properties supply the domains. The HEq specification of restrictedMap and [lem-pur-vector-chart-restricted-affine-transpose] identify restrictedMap at every exponent with affineTranspose on U.

At the fixed exponent apply [lem-pur-affine-unit-transpose-coordinates]. The first clause of [lem-pur-affine-ordered-integration-transposes] identifies the middle integrationTranspose with affineSpacePurityComparison. The resulting composite is definitionally orderedMap.
Rewrite both restricted maps using the first step and apply [lem-pur-affine-transpose-exponent-transition]. This gives the second conjunct of ChartComparison, including rank zero and empty schemes.
